# Awesome AI Design: full text

Source: https://github.com/jangtrinh/awesome-ai-design (CC0-1.0). 57 entries. Each line stands alone and can be quoted.

## Generate UI from a prompt

Prompt, sketch or screenshot in; screens, prototypes or running apps out.

v0 (https://v0.app): Vercel's chat-to-app builder that generates React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui interfaces. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Google Stitch (https://stitch.withgoogle.com): Google Labs experiment that turns prompts or sketches into UI designs and front-end code. It is of unverified price and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Uizard (https://uizard.io): Generates multi-screen app and web mockups from text, screenshots or hand-drawn sketches. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Magic Patterns (https://www.magicpatterns.com): Prompt-to-prototype tool that can build on your own design system components. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

UX Pilot (https://uxpilot.ai): Generates wireframes and hi-fi screens and exports them to design files and code. It is of unverified price and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Relume (https://www.relume.io): Generates sitemaps and wireframes for marketing sites, then exports to Webflow or design files. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Subframe (https://www.subframe.com): Visual editor with AI generation that outputs React and Tailwind code. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Bolt.new (https://bolt.new): StackBlitz's in-browser AI app builder that generates, runs and deploys full-stack web apps from a prompt. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Figr AI (https://figr.design): Design agent for product teams that generates UX flows and screens from product context such as live apps, design files and connected MCPs. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-14.

## Design with an agent on the canvas

Design editors where a person and an agent work on the same file.

DESIGN:OS Studio (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio): GPU-accelerated desktop interface design tool built in Rust, with a built-in MCP server so coding agents can read and edit the canvas. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Penpot (https://github.com/penpot/penpot): Open-source design and prototyping platform that also ships an official MCP server. It is free and open source under MPL-2.0. Runs: cloud or self-hosted. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Onlook (https://github.com/onlook-dev/onlook): Visual editor for React and Tailwind apps where you design in the browser and an AI agent writes the code. It is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Runs: cloud or local. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Framer (https://www.framer.com): Website builder with AI page generation, AI translation and on-canvas AI tools. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Paper (https://paper.design): Web and desktop design canvas built on HTML and CSS that IDE and CLI agents can read and write through the Paper MCP server. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: hybrid. Link checked 2026-11-13.

## Connect agents to design files

MCP servers and bridges that let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents read and write design files.

Figma MCP server (official) (https://github.com/figma/mcp-server-guide): Figma's official MCP server guide: gives coding agents design context, variables and code connect data. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: remote or desktop. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Framelink MCP for Figma (https://github.com/GLips/Figma-Context-MCP): Community MCP server that gives coding agents simplified layout and style data from Figma files. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Cursor Talk to Figma MCP (https://github.com/grab/cursor-talk-to-figma-mcp): Plugin plus MCP server that lets Cursor and other agents read and modify Figma designs. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

DESIGN:OS Bridge (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin): Plugin plus CLI that works with Figma: Claude Code, Codex or any shell agent can read and edit the open file over a local WebSocket, one undo step per change. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Penpot MCP server (https://help.penpot.app/mcp/): Official MCP server for Penpot so agents can inspect and change Penpot designs. It is free and open source under proprietary (SaaS). Runs: remote or local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Magic MCP (21st.dev) (https://github.com/21st-dev/magic-mcp): MCP server that generates UI components from natural-language prompts inside your IDE. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: local (API key). It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

shadcn/ui MCP server (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/mcp): Lets agents browse, search and install components from shadcn/ui-compatible registries. It is free and proprietary. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Canva MCP server (https://www.canva.dev/docs/connect/canva-mcp-server-setup/): Official Canva MCP server for creating and editing Canva designs from AI assistants. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: see docs. It is an MCP server or ships one. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Wensity UI (https://ui.wensity.com): Tailwind CSS component and block library with a CLI and an MCP server that let coding agents search components and write their source into a project. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Link checked 2026-11-13.

## Teach agents taste

Skills, specs and guidelines that change what an agent designs, not only how fast.

Anthropic Skills (frontend-design) (https://github.com/anthropics/skills): Official Agent Skills repo; the frontend-design skill steers agents away from generic-looking UI. It is free and licensed per component. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code. Link checked 2026-11-10.

UI UX Pro Max (https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): Agent skill with searchable styles, palettes, font pairings and UX rules for building UI. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

DESIGN.md (https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md): Format for describing a visual identity to coding agents in a single markdown file. It is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Runs: n/a. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Awesome DESIGN.md (https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md): Collection of DESIGN.md files that capture popular brand design systems for agents. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: n/a. Its docs name Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Web Interface Guidelines (https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines): Vercel's interface quality rules, packaged so agents can review UI against them. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: n/a. Link checked 2026-11-10.

design:os CLI (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os): Design CLI and skills for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity: describe a UI in plain words and get web, SwiftUI or design-file output checked by deterministic taste gates. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

## Keep output on your design system

Components, tokens and docs that keep generated UI on-brand.

shadcn/ui (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui): Copy-in component system and registry that most AI UI generators target. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Style Dictionary (https://github.com/style-dictionary/style-dictionary): Build system that turns design tokens into platform code, a common target for agent token pipelines. It is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Runs: local. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Tokens Studio (https://github.com/tokens-studio/figma-plugin): Manage design tokens in a design file and sync them with Git for code and agent use. It is freemium and open source under MIT. Runs: in design app. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Design Tokens Community Group format (https://github.com/design-tokens/community-group): The W3C community group spec for interoperable design token files. It is free and proprietary. Runs: n/a. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Storybook MCP (https://storybook.js.org/docs/ai/mcp/overview): Exposes your Storybook components and docs to agents so generated UI reuses real components. It is free and open source under proprietary (SaaS). Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

## Turn designs into code

Convert a finished design into production front-end code.

screenshot-to-code (https://github.com/abi/screenshot-to-code): Turns screenshots, mockups and design files into HTML, Tailwind, React or Vue code. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local or hosted. Its docs name Claude Code. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Anima (https://www.animaapp.com): Converts design files into React, HTML and Vue code with an AI coding layer. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Locofy (https://www.locofy.ai): Turns designs into front-end code for React, Next.js, React Native and more. It is of unverified price and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Builder.io Visual Copilot (https://www.builder.io/figma-to-code): Converts design files to code in your framework and maps them to your components. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Kombai (https://kombai.com): Frontend design and coding agent for desktop, VS Code and Cursor with an infinite canvas, Figma import, design systems and MCP integrations. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: hybrid. Link checked 2026-11-14.

## Make 3D with agents

Generate, edit and check 3D assets with models and agents.

MCP for Blender (https://github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender): Connects Blender to MCP clients so an agent can create, inspect and edit 3D scenes. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

DESIGN:OS 3D Blender (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender): Agent operating system for Blender 5.2: bpy knowledge base, execution contract and a 3D-print production gate. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

TRELLIS.2 (https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS.2): Microsoft's image-to-3D model that generates textured meshes. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local (GPU). Link checked 2026-11-10.

Meshy (https://www.meshy.ai): Text and image to 3D model generator with texturing and export to common formats. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Tripo (https://www.tripo3d.ai): AI 3D model generator from text or images, with auto-rigging. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Spline (https://spline.design): Browser 3D design tool with AI generation of 3D objects and textures. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

## Make vectors and motion

Vector generation, vectorising and agent-driven animation.

Remotion (https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion): Make videos with React; widely used by coding agents for programmatic motion. It is free for individuals and source-available under Remotion License (read from LICENSE.md). Runs: local. Its docs name Codex. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Remotion Agent Skills (https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills): Official agent skills that teach coding agents to write Remotion videos. It is free and of unclear licence. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

DESIGN:OS SVG Animation (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation): Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps video pipeline for AI agents. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

VTracer (https://github.com/visioncortex/vtracer): Converts raster images, including AI-generated ones, into clean SVG. It is free and open source under MIT. Runs: local. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Recraft (https://www.recraft.ai): Image generator that outputs editable vector graphics, icons and brand-consistent styles. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Rive (https://rive.app): Interactive animation editor and runtimes for state-machine driven motion. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Jitter (https://jitter.video): Motion design tool for UI and product animations, exports to video and Lottie. It is freemium and proprietary. Runs: cloud. Link checked 2026-11-10.

## Check what agents built

Screenshots, accessibility checks and user flows, so an agent can verify its own output.

Playwright MCP (https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp): Lets agents drive a real browser to check generated UI with screenshots and accessibility snapshots. It is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Chrome DevTools MCP (https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp): Gives agents DevTools access for layout, performance and visual debugging of what they built. It is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Runs: local. It is an MCP server or ships one. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor. Link checked 2026-11-10.

axe-core (https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core): Accessibility testing engine that agents can run against generated UI. It is free and open source under MPL-2.0. Runs: local. Link checked 2026-11-10.

DESIGN:OS code2flow (https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-code2flow): Turns a Next.js codebase into a user-flow canvas with real screenshots per screen and code-evidenced transitions, 100% local. It is free and source-available under PolyForm Shield. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Made by the maintainer of Awesome AI Design. Link checked 2026-11-10.

Markagent (https://markagent.avibebuilder.com): Chrome extension that turns clicks on page elements into a markdown feedback prompt with selectors and source file paths for coding agents. It is free and of unclear licence. Runs: local. Its docs name Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Link checked 2026-11-14.
